title: Close the delivery-audit blockers, fix two tenant-lifecycle gaps and one UI inconsistency, and publish v0.17.1
goal: The 2026-10-22 independent delivery audit of main 92b94474 returned FAIL on delivery completeness: no P0, but (1) Release Gate was red with 8 unresolved SonarCloud issues so no release could be cut from main, (2) the remediation lived only in an uncommitted worktree, and (3) consumer-facing docs contradicted the code and the published release. The same audit found two tenant-lifecycle gaps (an archived tenant could never be deleted because the archived-terminal rule and the last-owner rule deadlock; a failed provisioning stranded its tenant row holding a UNIQUE code) and one UI inconsistency (the dictionary governance bar rendered a description under each metric while every other system list does not). This packet closes all of them, records the evidence, and publishes v0.17.1 with the four consumable assets.
findings: A1 (P1, blocks release): Release Gate on main 92b94474 failed (run 39733491324) with 'Release blocked: 8 unresolved SonarCloud issue(s)': go:S1192 x3 and go:S3776 x1 in tenant_provision.go, typescript:S3776 in useLayoutMenu.tsx, typescript:S6759 x3, typescript:S6582 in useTenantSessionStore.ts.

A2 (P1, delivery completeness): the remediation for A1 and the tenant contract deviations existed only as 30 modified + 4 untracked files on branch fix/tenant-plan-entitlements-and-audit, with no evidence directory and an in-progress task packet, so nothing could be frozen.

A3 (P1, downstream consumption): README/README.en named v0.16.1 while v0.17.0 was published; docs/api/TENANT_API.md documented /api/v1/tenants* which answers 404 in the running build; the scope matrix still called the runtime single-tenant; the deployment guide never mentioned tenant_mode.
B1 (P2): DeleteTenant required zero active members while RemoveMember refuses to drop the last owner, so an archived (retired) tenant could never be deleted through the API.
B2 (P2): CreateTenant inserted the tenant row outside the provisioning transaction; a provisioning failure left the row holding its UNIQUE code with no owner, repairable only by hand.
C1 (P3, UI): the dictionary page's governance bar rendered a description under each of its three metrics, unlike every other system list, pushing the table down by three lines.

D1 (P2, found while preparing this release): 000020_tenant_phase1_core_tables.down.sql dropped indexes and columns unconditionally while 000024.down had already removed several of them, so `migrate down` aborted part-way with 'Error 1091: Can't DROP tenant_id' and left schema_migrations dirty with a half-dropped schema.

acceptanceCriteria: The eight SonarCloud rules are addressed in code without suppressions; Release Gate is green on the release commit.

An archived tenant with active members can be deleted; the memberships are disabled, the code is released and the status becomes deleted, all in one transaction. A live tenant with members is still refused with tenant.has_active_members.
A provisioning failure removes the tenant row, so the same code can be created again immediately.
The migration chain rolls back to version 0 and re-applies to the same clean version on a throwaway database; the down file is guarded rather than unconditional.
The dictionary governance bar shows only label + value, matching /system/user and /system/post; no unused i18n key remains in any of the five locales.

README(zh/en), CHANGELOG, RELEASE_NOTES and VERSION all state 0.17.1; TENANT_API documents the mounted /system/tenant surface; the scope matrix no longer calls the runtime single-tenant; DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE documents tenant_mode.
go build/vet/gofmt clean, go test ./... against real MySQL + Redis with 0 failures and 0 skips; frontend tsc/eslint/vitest/prebuild/vite build pass; docs governance checkers pass.
v0.17.1 is tagged and published with tgz / tgz.sha256 / repo.tar / repo.tar.sha256, checksums verified, and Foundation Release Verify green.

doNotTouch: the published v0.17.0 tag and assets

implementationNotes: DeleteTenant reads id/code/status first, then counts active members: memberCount > 0 && status != archived still returns tenant.has_active_members. For an archived tenant the transaction disables the active memberships, releases the code and sets status=deleted, so contract §2.2 (non-archived only) stays intact while §2.1's retirement path becomes reachable.

CreateTenant compensates with Unscoped().Delete on the tenant row: the row never became usable, and keeping it would hold a UNIQUE code with no owner. When the compensating delete itself fails, both errors are logged and the original failure is still returned.
The dictionary page only drops the description field of the three metrics; label/value/action and the governance rail are untouched.
Version material follows docs/VERSION_MANAGEMENT_GUIDE.md §6: patch release, no migration, no consumer-facing interface change.
